title: DPAA Identifies Pfc. William A. Gervais Jr., Missing in Germany
detail: On November 3, 2026, the DPAA announced that Army Pfc. William A. Gervais Jr., 28, of New Bedford, Massachusetts, missing in action in Germany in WWII, had been identified. He is to be buried in his hometown on December 7, 2026. The agency reported a record 250 identifications in fiscal 2026, 198 of them WWII service members.
